title: Desk pack v0
description: A pack (ADR 0108): a data-only plugin that brings a service's connector, views and layout as one. It runs no code: its pack block names the plugins it brings, the commands its Apply runs and the profile it lays out.

PackBlock.description: What a pack brings and does when it is applied.

plugins.description: The plugins it brings, by id: each nested in the pack folder under plugins/<folder>/ (installed and removed with the pack) or a plugin the desk has. Connectors first: Apply opens Settings, Connections on the first connector.

opens.description: Commands Apply runs once the pack is on, in order: a board, a timeline.

profile.description: The profile it contributes (contributes.profiles) that Apply switches to: its layout.

services.description: The words a person names the service by: github, 깃허브. Make with Eris finds the pack by them.

PackCommand.description: One command Apply runs, with its arguments.
